page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg7.24xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor. Running on a KVM hypervisor, this instance provides 96 dedicated physical cores with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, meaning hyperthreading is disabled. The processor operates at a base clock speed of 3.3 GHz, delivering high-frequency compute performance.

The server is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, which translates to a resource density of 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include local storage or integrated GPUs, requiring external block storage for operating system and application data. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated physical core allocation and high clock speed position this instance for compute-heavy workloads that require predictable execution. The lack of local storage and GPU acceleration represents a tradeoff, making it less suitable for local data-intensive caching or deep learning workloads. It is best suited for high-performance computing, intensive web serving, batch processing, and compute-bound enterprise applications.
